collisionAudit.note: Every independently moving rigid surface is transformed to world space before the triangle-overlap query. Only a barrel telescoping inside its own authored rigid vane housing is allowlisted, with a pinned maximum of 60 additional triangle pairs above that clip's frame-1 cradle baseline. Foreign pair identities remain zero-tolerance. In addition to the sampled general ledger, explicit static-hull, hatch, keep-stage, neighboring-kit, and gun cross-pairs are swept over every integer Tower deploy, aggregate recoil, and per-vane recoil frame. Numeric stowage and sleeve-engagement gates cover closed-solid containment that surface BVHs cannot detect.
